thread:
Olivia: FYI — postmortem for Cust-River's Dedicated cluster is up. Root causes: intermittent VPC peering flaps + on-prem NAT port exhaustion leading to instance isolation. Summary + initial action items below.

Raj: Thanks — can we get owners and a timeline? Is this a one-off or a recurring class of failures? :eyes:

Emma: Short answer: recurring. We've seen similar long-tail peering regressions across 3 customers in the last 6 months, usually triggered during heavy control-plane churn. This one was amplified by on-prem NAT limits.

Marta: Repro notes from the lab: when we replayed the workload against the peer, the TCP handshake stalls after ~250 concurrent connections. On-prem firewall silently drops SYN_RECV. Log snippet:```
Nov 12 03:21:09 fw01 kernel: nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
Nov 12 03:21:09 custom-fw: conntrack limit reached
```

Raj: Assigning owners: I'll take network-side remediation (peering stability + monitoring), Marta please take the on-prem reproducibility & advise CS on best-practice NAT sizing. Emma — can you track the customer comms and SLA impact?

Olivia: Assigning CS owner to Emma for external comms and interim mitigation (route failover + keepalive tuning). Please confirm ETA for customer update. :calendar:

Marta: Proposed tech action items (short):
- create small client-side keepalive at 15s to reduce idle conn churn
- add conntrack alert when table > 80%
- recommend NAT pool increase for Cust-River and provide sizing guidance
- file a follow-up to examine asymmetric routing during peak bursts

Raj: Operational plan (short):
- Temporary: enable automated peering fallback to regional replica for 72h window (implemented as policy flag) — target ETA 6h.
- Mid: add BGP hold-time and dead-peer detection tuning for peering (ETA 2 weeks).
- Long: instrument peering control-plane for per-customer retransmit rates and schedule quarterly peering stress tests (ETA 90 days).

DeployBot: Created tickets INC-52321 (isolation incident), REM-52322 (peering hardening), CS-52323 (customer comms). Links: https://jira.redwood/INC-52321, https://jira.redwood/REM-52322

Emma: Customer update draft: "We're continuing to monitor your dedicated cluster and have applied temporary routing failovers to maintain availability. We're coordinating a permanent fix and will provide timeline by 2024-11-15." Please review and approve.

Raj: Noting cross-customer pattern: devex/infra — can we add a recurring cadence review to the incidents rotation to look for long-tail peering regressions? Proposal: monthly "peering cadence" review with Eng-SRE, Eng-Platform, and CS lead.

Marta: I'll run a short test harness to reproduce NAT exhaustion with synthetic client churn and document kernel conntrack tuning steps. Will post results here.

Olivia: Thanks all — please add any missing action items to the Jira tickets and mark owners in the remediation checklist. We'll reconvene in the peering cadence review next week. :thumbsup:

Emma: acked. Adding note to CS runbook about proactive NAT sizing for new on-prem installs.

Raj: adding follow-up: collect last 6 months of peering BGP flaps for customers with Dedicated deployments and correlate with control-plane deploy windows. ETA: 2024-11-01.

Marta: quick command I used for reproduction (for the runbook):```
for i in {1..500}; do nc -z -w1 ${PEER_IP} $((1024 + $i % 2000)) & done; sleep 1; netstat -s | grep -i conntrack;```

Olivia: Great. If anyone hits blockers ask for escalation on #eng-oncall. Closing thread after cadence meeting notes are posted.
